laps._source: session.laps — one row per driver per lap, from FastF1's parsed timing feed
laps.Time: timedelta64. Session time at which this lap's time was registered (i.e. when the car crossed the line to complete the lap).
laps.LapTime: timedelta64. Total time to complete the lap. Null for in-laps/out-laps/installation laps where the sector chain didn't close cleanly.
laps.LapNumber: float. Lap count within the session, shared reference frame across all drivers (does not reset at pit stops).
laps.Stint: float. Increments each time the driver's tyre is changed; starts at 1. Distinct from tyre age — a new stint always starts a new tyre-age count from FreshTyre state.
laps.PitOutTime: timedelta64, non-null only on the lap a car leaves the pits (an out-lap). NaT otherwise.
laps.PitInTime: timedelta64, non-null only on the lap a car enters the pits (an in-lap). NaT otherwise.
laps.Sector1Time / Sector2Time / Sector3Time: timedelta64. Duration of each of the three timing sectors.
laps.Sector1SessionTime / Sector2SessionTime: timedelta64. Absolute session time at which each sector split was recorded (not a duration).
laps.SpeedI1: float, km/h. Speed trap reading at intermediate timing point 1.
laps.SpeedI2: float, km/h. Speed trap reading at intermediate timing point 2.
laps.SpeedFL: float, km/h. Speed trap reading at the finish line.
laps.SpeedST: float, km/h. Speed trap reading on the straight designated as the 'speed trap' for that circuit.
laps.IsPersonalBest: bool. Whether this lap was that driver's best of the session at the time it was set.
laps.Compound: str. SOFT / MEDIUM / HARD / INTERMEDIATE / WET / UNKNOWN. Relative labels re-assigned by Pirelli each event — see data/reference/compound_allocation.json for the physical C1-C5 mapping.
laps.TyreLife: float. Cumulative laps completed on this physical tyre set, INCLUDING laps run in a prior session if the set wasn't fresh. This is the tyre-age signal degradation models key off.
laps.FreshTyre: bool. Whether the set was new (never used before) when fitted for this stint.
laps.Team: str. Constructor name at time of session.
laps.LapStartTime: timedelta64. Session time at which the lap began (previous lap's finish line crossing).
laps.LapStartDate: datetime64, wall-clock timestamp of lap start. Frequently unpopulated depending on what FastF1 could reconstruct from the feed — do not rely on it being present.
laps.TrackStatus: str, one or more concatenated digit codes describing conditions during the lap: 1=AllClear, 2=Yellow, 3=?(unused), 4=SCDeployed, 5=Red, 6=VSCDeployed, 7=VSCEnding. A lap spanning a status change carries multiple digits, e.g. '12'.
laps.Position: float. Track position (1st, 2nd, ...) at the end of the lap.
laps.Deleted: bool. Whether stewards deleted this lap time (most commonly a track-limits infringement).
laps.DeletedReason: str, free text from race control explaining a deletion (empty string if not deleted). e.g. 'TRACK LIMITS AT TURN 4 LAP 31'.
laps.FastF1Generated: bool. True if FastF1 synthesized this row itself (e.g. interpolated) rather than reading it directly off the official timing feed.
laps.IsAccurate: bool. FastF1's own internal consistency check (sector times sum correctly, no timing anomalies). The primary trust flag used to exclude laps before any degradation analysis.

weather._source: session.weather_data — one row roughly every 60 seconds through the session, independent of the laps table
weather.Time: timedelta64. Session time of the reading.
weather.Rainfall: bool. Rain sensor flag — can trip briefly on light drizzle that doesn't change tyre choice, so treat as a hint not a verdict on 'wet session'.
weather.TrackTemp: float, °C. Track surface temperature — the more physically relevant temperature for tyre degradation than air temp.

results._source: session.results — one row per driver, session-final classification
results.ClassifiedPosition: str. Position as officially classified — can be 'R' (retired), 'D' (disqualified), 'W' (withdrawn) instead of a number.
results.Q1 / Q2 / Q3: timedelta64. Qualifying segment best times (qualifying sessions only, NaT for race/practice).
results.Time: timedelta64. Race time — absolute for the winner, gap-to-winner for others.
results.Status: str. 'Finished', '+1 Lap', or a retirement reason ('Accident', 'Engine', ...).

track_status._source: session.track_status — sparse event log, one row per status CHANGE (not per lap)
track_status.Time: timedelta64. Session time the status changed.
track_status.Status: str digit code, same scheme as laps.TrackStatus (1=AllClear, 2=Yellow, 4=SC, 5=Red, 6=VSC, 7=VSCEnding).

race_control_messages._source: session.race_control_messages — the official FIA race control log
race_control_messages.Message: str. Free-text message as issued by race control.
race_control_messages.Status: str, nullable. e.g. 'ENABLED'/'DISABLED' for DRS messages.
race_control_messages.Scope: str, nullable. 'Track', 'Sector', 'Driver' — what the message applies to.
race_control_messages.RacingNumber: nullable. Car number, if the message targets one driver.
race_control_messages.Lap: int. Lap number the message was issued on.
